question: Should OpenClaw adopt the public Plugin SDK readiness-criterion contract and the associated hosting-profile configuration as supported product surface before this profile layer is considered for landing?
rationale: The branch adds permanent Plugin SDK and operator configuration contracts, while the related prerequisite PR explicitly presents that API as a maintainer decision; code review cannot choose the repository’s long-term compatibility commitment.

options.title: Stage the approved contracts
options.body: Approve or narrow the readiness API in the prerequisite PRs, then rebase this work to a profile-only branch and require the exact package-installed Docker matrix.

options.title: Keep readiness core-only
options.body: Decline public plugin criteria for V1 and revise the profile design to use only accepted core-owned observations.

options.title: Defer hosting profiles
options.body: Pause this stack until maintainers want to own the new readiness and deployment-posture contracts.

recommendation.title: Stage the approved contracts
recommendation.body: Approve or narrow the readiness API in the prerequisite PRs, then rebase this work to a profile-only branch and require the exact package-installed Docker matrix.

likelyOwner.reason: A named current-main owner could not be established safely from the supplied history; this requires an explicit Gateway and Plugin SDK product decision.
